messages.subject: simplify renderUI further
parts:
I am wondering whether renderUI or conditional panel can be simplified and be generated dynamically.  For example, I have a bunch of functions to generate various plots or summary.   Can I generate condition panel automatically or dynamically without "hard" coding, basing on selected arguments, input method for argument (select, range, ...), default value with option to change, ...?

What I envision is a generateUI function that will take the name of a function, args, input method for selected args, default, and output method, then generate an UI or conditional panel.  I will appreciate your help.

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: simplify renderUI further
parts:
I suspect it can be done. In the below gist it uses htmlOutput("selectInputs") to dynamically output whatever html is passed to it. And it registers whatever shiny component that gets output to the htmlOutput as Shiny inputs as well.

shiny::runGist("6684134")

https://gist.github.com/xiaodaigh/6684134

However I don't think there is a ready made function for your needs though.
